description: Chatbot flow regression set (docs/chatbot-flow-improvement-plan.md Task 5). Each case is a script of turns run in one fresh session. Expectations are loose, machine-checkable properties; answer quality is read by a human from the table. topic_changed / memory_summary_present expectations exist from Phase 2.
